name: Reconcile a workbook example and correct a missing review field
description: Verifies the primary review workflow corrects a concrete missing field, preserves an amendment and resumes after refresh.
steps: If a saved workspace exists, clear it using Clear workspace and confirm. Choose Explore a synthetic example or استكشاف مثال تجريبي.
Open Findings / الأخطاء والملاحظات and open the missing Cluster reviewer / اسم مسؤول التجمع field finding for Summary Sheet!C28.
Use the Summary Sheet!C28 location link to navigate to Data & amendments. Enter Verified Reviewer into the Cluster reviewer C28 input.
Verify the missing C28 finding is gone and the amendment history records the field change.
Without clicking Save, wait for Saved on device / محفوظ على الجهاز, refresh the page, then return to File details in Data & amendments.
expected: The C28 field retains Verified Reviewer after refresh, the amendment history retains the edit, and the missing C28 finding remains resolved. The source is clearly labeled synthetic demo data. Persistence is automatic; no manual Save click is required.

name: Review a finding, filter results and inspect all KPI sources in English
covers: ED Audit branding in Arabic and English
description: Verifies review notes and filters work while definition ambiguities remain visible in the KPI view.
steps: Clear any existing workspace with confirmation, load the synthetic example, and switch to English if needed. Verify the app is named ED Audit.
Open Findings, search for Four-hour, open the matching finding, write Cohort exclusions requested in Reviewer note and check the reviewed checkbox. Click Done.
Filter Review status to Reviewed and verify that the documented finding is listed. Reopen it and verify the note remains. Close it.
Open Performance indicators. Inspect all eight indicators and expand the Calculation & source section for Disposition within 4 hours.
Open Definitions & audit rules and search for exclusions. Expand the four-hour definition and the original wording. Switch back to Arabic.

Open Possible corrections / التصحيحات الممكنة. Verify H19 has before and after formulas, a B7 explanation, and an Apply correction button. The reviewer name and four-hour exclusions must appear under Requires source review without automatic replacement values.

Apply the H19 correction. Verify it moves to Applied corrections and the other unresolved findings remain. Wait for Saved on device, refresh, and reopen Possible corrections to verify the correction is retained.

Open Audit report and verify the amendment includes H19, its before and after formulas, explanation and B7 source. Return to Possible corrections and click Undo correction. Verify the H19 correction is offered again and its original formula finding returns.
expected: The reviewed finding and note remain visible through filtering and language switching. The four-hour KPI is explicitly a workbook rate before exclusions and its definition-compliant result is unavailable. Definitions show source wording and benchmarks; the interface changes to Arabic and RTL. The app name is ED Audit in both languages and the Arabic descriptor is تدقيق بيانات الطوارئ. The H19 correction is explained, applied, preserved after reload, reported, and reversible. No missing names or unresolvable cohort counts are filled automatically.

name: Amend a number on mobile, reject invalid counts and revert with confirmation
description: Verifies mobile users can edit data and that invalid inputs do not create apparently valid KPI results.
steps: Clear any existing workspace with confirmation, load the synthetic example and switch to English if needed.
Use the mobile menu to open Data & amendments. Select ED statistics and change Total patients H2 to -1.
Use the mobile menu to open Findings and verify an invalid numeric value finding appears. Open Performance indicators and verify door-to-doctor is unavailable.
Return to ED statistics and blank H2. Verify the required numeric cell finding is now shown rather than a zero value.

Open Pain management, clear G3, and type 0.5 one character at a time rather than pasting. Leave the field and verify 0.5 remains. Repeat with 12.5 and verify it remains 12.5, then return to ED statistics.
In Data & amendments click Revert amendments and cancel; verify H2 remains blank. Then revert again and confirm.
expected: Negative counts and blanks are flagged and dependent KPIs are unavailable. Cancel preserves the amendment. Confirmed revert restores H2 to the synthetic original 100 and clears amendment history. Mobile controls remain usable without page-wide horizontal scrolling. Fractional G3 values retain their decimal point during typing and after leaving the field.

name: Export a report and restore a real downloaded JSON backup
covers: malformed JSON rejection preserves current audit
original source total error after dependent amendment
highlighted amendments and retained source workbook
description: Verifies a downloaded backup can be uploaded again and reproduces a concrete amended audit.
steps: Clear any existing workspace with confirmation and load the synthetic example. Switch to English if needed.
Open Data & amendments, File details, and enter Backup Reviewer in Cluster reviewer C28.
Open Audit report and download JSON audit backup. Also export report CSV and verify a CSV download starts.

Create a malformed JSON copy from the actual downloaded backup by adding an extra top-level sheets entry with cells:null (for example sheets.extra = {cells:null}), upload that copy, and verify a visible invalid-backup error appears while Backup Reviewer and the active audit remain. Use the original unmodified downloaded backup for the next steps.
Clear the workspace and confirm. Use Choose file on the empty overview to upload the actual JSON backup downloaded in the earlier step.
Open File details and Amendment history, then Audit report.

Generate genuine full.xlsx and partial.xlsx test workbooks using tests/xlsx-fixture.mjs (workbookFixture() and workbookFixture({partial:true})); retain both original files. Clear the workspace and import partial.xlsx. Enter Partial Reviewer into C28, wait for Saved on device and refresh. Verify C28 and missing-sheet findings remain. Download its JSON backup and restore that actual file; confirm replacement when prompted. Verify the same missing-sheet findings and C28 remain.

Clear the workspace and import full.xlsx. In ED statistics change I2 from 600 to 601. Open Findings and search ED_Statistics!I7: an original source total error must remain alongside a separate stored-total-needs-refresh warning.

Open File details and enter Excel Reviewer into C28. Open Audit report and choose Export amended Excel — select original. Select partial.xlsx and verify a source-mismatch error without replacing the current audit. Repeat with full.xlsx and verify an amended XLSX download and recalculation guidance.

Open the downloaded XLSX using an independent spreadsheet reader. Verify C28 is Excel Reviewer, I2 is 601, amended cells have yellow fill, original formatting and the Notes sheet remain, and formulas request recalculation. The selected original full.xlsx must remain unchanged.
expected: The uploaded backup restores Backup Reviewer, the amendment history and synthetic source label. The audit report contains findings, evidence, eight KPIs and CTAS reconciliation. CSV and JSON downloads are produced. No data is sent to an app backend. The malformed JSON is rejected with a visible error and the current review remains usable; the original valid backup still restores correctly. Partial workbooks remain restorable and incomplete rather than being fabricated as complete. The original total error remains after dependent input edits. Excel export rejects the wrong source and produces a separate copy with highlighted amendments, preserved source formatting and recalculation instructions.

name: Reject an unrelated file without discarding the active audit
description: Verifies invalid imports preserve active work and a new manual review correctly exposes missing required data.
steps: Clear any existing workspace with confirmation, load the synthetic example and switch to English if needed.
Export report CSV, then use Replace file to attempt uploading that CSV as an input file by setting the file input to the downloaded CSV, even though the picker normally filters extensions.
Verify an error explains only XLSX or JSON are supported, and the synthetic audit still has 1000 total patients.
Clear the workspace, confirm and choose Or enter data manually. Inspect File details and ED statistics without entering zero into the blank cells.
Open Audit report and verify the report contains missing-field errors and unavailable dependent KPI values. Verify the Print / Save PDF control is available.

Using browser test instrumentation, make Storage.setItem throw QuotaExceededError for miyar-ed-workspace-v1 only. Enter Unsaved Reviewer in C28. Verify the autosave failure message is visible and the entered value remains. Dispatch a cancelable beforeunload event and verify it is canceled while the changes remain unsaved.
Download the JSON backup despite the storage failure. Verify it contains Unsaved Reviewer. Remove the injected storage fault after this test.
expected: Unsupported input produces a visible error and does not replace the current audit. Manual entry starts with genuinely blank fields, required-data findings and unavailable KPIs. A printable report is available. A storage failure preserves edits in memory, offers JSON backup recovery, and activates the unsaved-exit warning; the downloaded backup contains the unsaved amendment.
